design_philosophy.core_concept: Realistic Earth-to-Moon journey, scale, science, silence
design_philosophy.tone: NASA-grade precision, cinematic distance, documentary-style fidelity

headings.usage: Marketing hero sections, large impact statements

telemetry.family: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
telemetry.usage: HUD data, timestamps, coordinates, technical mission indicators
telemetry.tracking: tracking-widest for labels, tabular-nums for data

textures: High-contrast black/white masking for structural clarity
lighting: Harsh stark white solar glare for 3D elements
No soft diffuse colored ambient lighting
borders: Technical crosshairs (+ marks) at container corners

marketing_page.hero: Full viewport immersive 3D canvas (Earth/Moon) with absolute positioned UI overlay. UI must float silently over the deep space background.
marketing_page.bento_grid: Asymmetric 'Tetris' grid (cols-12) for mission phases with wide gaps (gap-8).

mission_hud.structure: Modular, role-specific layout. Edges of screen hold critical telemetry (speed, altitude). Open center for 3D view. Follows NASA Open MCT principles.
mission_hud.components: Synoptic displays, minimal frames, pure data emphasis, tabular alignment.

motion.transitions: Slow, cinematic fades. No bouncy spring animations.
motion.hud: Data numbers ticking with tabular-nums. Blinking cursors or technical glitch-reveal for new data.
motion.3d: Extremely slow, realistic orbital momentum (use Lenis for smooth scroll on marketing, Drei for 3D dampening)

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn primitives but heavily strip them down. Remove rounded corners (use rounded-none or rounded-sm max). Use 1px borders instead of shadows. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx), use standard JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all React components.
components.buttons: Square edges, transparent background with 1px border, filled with NASA orange on hover.
components.cards: Cardless or 'Grid Borders' style. Use pure borders and technical markers (e.g., small squares at corners).

media.3d_strategy: Use <Environment> from Drei for harsh spatial lighting. Earth and Moon must use high-res textures with realistic displacement and atmospheric shaders. Keep the void pure black.

earth_crescent.description: Crescent Earth for cinematic hero or transition backgrounds

mission_control.description: Mission control panel for the About/Vision section

accessibility.contrast: Maintain strictly high contrast. Light grey on black for secondary text, pure white on black for primary. Orange ONLY for interactive or alert.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or heavily structured grid layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, especially over 3D canvases.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but tint them grey/black, not transparent.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide React.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Incorporate data-testid attributes for everything interactive.
ALL files MUST be standard JavaScript (.js or .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
